messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPEN: Egress surge causing high token queueing in west-us3 zones b/c. Pager duty: @sre-oncall-kai paging. 1887654305

sre-oncall-kai: seeing proxy error counters spike in west-us3-zoneb & zonec; latency SLO breached on text-gen. Investigating.

alex-netops: BGP flaps observed on provider peer gcp-west-us3-bgp-2 from ~1887654280. SNAT exhaustion on some egress hosts. Paging peering team. https://internal.netops/peers/peering-345

mike-runtime: telemetry: batching backlog x4, KV cache misses up. Recent canary rollout may have amplified. Prepared rollback plan for canary v2.3.1. Quick checks:
```
kubectl -n runtime get pods -l app=egress-proxy -o wide
ss -tunap | grep 443 | wc -l
```

tara-product: Notifying CS: small subset of Dedicated customers in west-us3 may experience 5xxs.

jenny-cs: Draft customer note:
"We're experiencing degraded throughput from west-us3. We're rerouting to adjacent regions. No data loss. Reply here or open a ticket if impacted."

alex-netops: Immediate mitigation: route edge egress away from west-us3 -> west-us2 60%, west-us1 40%, west-us3 0. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --prefix "/api/v1/generate" --weights west-us3=0,west-us2=60,west-us1=40
```
Convergence ~30s.

mike-runtime: Prewarming KV cache in west-us2 to absorb surge:
```
infra/ops cache prewarm --region west-us2 --prefix /api/v1/generate --workers 10
```

sre-oncall-kai: routing change applied. monitoring queues & 5xx.

incident-bot: Routing update executed at 1887654360. Error rate improved from 45%->10% in west-us2 within 90s; west-us1 latency +12ms.

mike-runtime: residual NAT timeouts on small cohort. Scaling proxies in west-us3 and keeping traffic drained.

alex-netops: Provider cleared BGP flaps at 1887654440. Plan staged return: test 20% -> 50% -> full every 10m if stable.

tara-product: Status page suggested copy:
"We are investigating increased errors and latency for west-us3. Traffic is being routed to west-us2 and west-us1. Next update in 15m."

jenny-cs: Customer push template:
"Hi — elevated errors via west-us3. Traffic temporarily routed to neighboring regions; minor latency increase possible. No data loss expected."

ops-handoff-bot: Handoff note (30m): issue summary, actions, metrics. Next oncall mike-runtime to run resumption test at 1887654800.

sre-oncall-kai: handing off in 20. Escalate to @tara-product and @jenny-cs for customer escalations.

incident-bot: STATUSPAGE UPDATE POSTED at 1887654405: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-999

mike-runtime: Resumption test steps at 1887654800: increase west-us3 to 20% while reducing west-us2 by 10%; watch 5xx for 5m; rollback if spike >3x baseline.

alex-netops: Fallback if SNAT recurs: add secondary NAT pool + iptables MASQUERADE. Snippet:
```
sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
```

sre-oncall-kai: token queue stable, 5xx holding ~8-10%. handing off.

ops-handoff-bot: Handoff complete at 1887654990. Next oncall: mike-runtime. Mitigations documented: https://internal.runbooks/egress-surge-west-us3

jenny-cs: will follow up in-thread for customer replies. Thanks all.
